_comment: ESCROW-LEDGER-SIGN-01 shrink-only baseline. These 39 hold rows were written by the pre-fix writer (Math.abs() forced every row positive, sign discarded) and predate the fix in escrow-ledger-sign.ts. Per the owner's own ruling: 'FIX THE WRITER, not the rows -- the rows purge.'
